title: Told sensor research would be career-ending
place_text: US intelligence community / his own lab

tellings.quote:
intelligence community told me
>> like I was starting to work in my own
lab to reproduce it and to come up with
a sensor to sense this stuff.

plain: A former US intelligence official named Eric Haseltine says that when he began working in his own lab to reproduce an effect he had come across, and to build a sensor that could detect it, people in the intelligence community warned him off. He tells Michels this happened to him, and that he was given to understand the work would end his career, which, if true, would mean such research was being actively discouraged.
